shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat panel
symmetrical or paired arrangement about a vertical axis
justification: A depicts a figural scene in two registers with standing human figures facing one another, raised arms, ritual objects and inscribed signs, while B is a purely vegetal design of palmettes, volutes and radiating fronds arranged symmetrically about a central stem. The only real commonalities are shallow relief on a panel, vertical stacking of repeated units and axial symmetry, plus a loose resemblance between B's fan-palmettes and the rosette-like details in A; there is no shared specific motif or relationship.
